view.title: Skills
view.subtitle: Turn repetitive work into safe, reusable rules for Fruition Agent.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this skill?
deleteConfirm.description: The skill “/{slug}” and all its saved versions will be deleted. This can't be undone.

runCoach.title: Select a document to run on.
runCoach.descriptionLine1: For document skills, pick the document to edit (or the document to summarize or convert,
runCoach.descriptionLine2: or the folder for the new document).
runCoach.descriptionLine3: For folder skills, pick the folder to organize.

kindDescriptions.document: Creates a new document or edits the open one. You review a preview before anything is saved.
kindDescriptions.folder: Creates, renames, and moves folders and documents in the tree. Only the items you approve are saved.

sourceHint.unset: If you leave this unselected, the source is read only when the rules include the '{문서}' (document) placeholder. Click “Write with AI” and AI will choose for you.
sourceHint.read: When run on a folder, it reads the documents in that folder as the source and creates a new document
sourceHint.skip: Creates a new document without a source

help.label: About {label}
help.scopePersonal: Personal - Available in all your workspaces.
help.scopeTeam: Team - Available in the current workspace.
help.resultCreate: Create a new document - Saves the result as a new document.
help.resultEdit: Edit the open document - Edits the document it runs on directly.
help.resultAuto: Decide automatically - Agent chooses based on the request.
help.sourceRead: Read - When run on a folder, reads the Markdown documents in it (up to the 20 most recent); when run on a document, reads that document as the source.
help.sourceSkip: Don't read - Creates a new document from the rules alone, without a source.

form.resultHint: With 'Decide automatically', Agent asks you when the target is unclear.
form.resultNote: Changed the result to “{mode}” to match the AI draft.
form.sourceNote: AI set the source document to “{value}” to match the rules.
form.scopeTeamHint: Team: Available in the current workspace.
form.commandHint: Type / in the Agent input to find the skill by this name.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Summarizes the overview of a research document in three key sentences.
form.rulesPlaceholder:
Edit only the 'Research overview' section. Don't change other sections.
Don't add numbers or facts that aren't in the source.
form.rulesHint: Add '{문서}' (document), '{선택한 부분}' (selected text), or '{요청}' (request) and they're filled in when the skill runs.

validation.commandPattern: Commands can only use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. meeting-summary).
validation.commandTaken: This command is already in use. Enter a different command.
validation.descriptionTooLong: Descriptions can be up to {max, number} characters.
validation.rulesTooLong: Rules can be up to {max, number} characters.

authorError.rejectedTitle: The skill review request was declined.
authorError.rejected: The request wasn't clear, or it's something a skill can't do. Describe exactly what the skill should do.
authorError.unavailable: AI review isn't responding right now. Please try again in a moment.
authorError.unsupported: A skill can't do this. Describe it as writing, editing, folder organization, or a template.
authorError.referenceTooLarge: Each reference document can be up to 30,000 characters. Choose a shorter document.

saveError.targetsInvalid: Couldn't save because the target doesn't fit this skill. Check the target.
saveError.resultModeInvalid: Couldn't save because the result doesn't fit the skill type. Choose the skill type and result again.
saveError.capabilitiesInvalid: This skill type can't be saved. Choose the skill type and result again.

review.clarifyTitle: Make the rules a bit more specific.
review.clarifyFallback: Describe what the skill should do in a bit more detail.
review.issueFallback: The safety review found risky wording.
review.issuesTitle: Couldn't save because of the safety review. Please revise the rules.

categories.sensitive_info: Content that looks like sensitive information
categories.tool_policy: Use of a tool that isn't allowed
categories.permission_escalation: Wording that tries to expand permissions
categories.forbidden_tool: Use of a tool that isn't allowed
categories.role_override: Wording that tries to change the AI's role
categories.instruction_override: Wording that tells the AI to ignore existing instructions
categories.secret: Content that looks like a secret

assist.author: Write with AI
assist.idleHint: AI refines your rules using what you wrote and the reference documents.
assist.reviewFound: The safety review found something to fix.
assist.filled: Filled in the rules AI wrote. Review them, then save.

create.title: New skill
create.subtitle: Turn repetitive work into safe, reusable rules for Fruition Agent.
create.prefilled: Filled in from your Agent request “{request}”. Edit only what you need.
create.autoPublished: Published the AI draft without review because of the 'AI agent auto-approval' setting. If you don't need it, delete it from the Skills screen.

picker.uploadHint: .md, .txt · Not shown in the main document list.

referenceUpload.pdf: PDFs can't be used as reference documents. Upload a Markdown (.md) or text (.txt) file.
referenceUpload.unsupportedType: Only Markdown (.md) or text (.txt) files can be uploaded as reference documents.
referenceUpload.tooLarge: Markdown files must be 5 MB or smaller to use as reference documents.
referenceUpload.duplicateName: A reference document with the same name already exists. Rename the file and upload it again.
referenceUpload.inProgress: The same upload is already in progress. Please try again in a moment.
referenceUpload.invalid: This file can't be used as a reference document. Check the file and upload it again.
referenceUpload.failed: Couldn't upload the reference document. Please try again in a moment.

testRun.title: Test run
testRun.subtitle: Check the result on one document before saving. The document won't change.
testRun.folderNote: Folder organization skills don't support test runs. After saving, run it from the Tasks tab to review the plan before you approve it.
testRun.noDocuments: There are no Markdown documents to test. Create a document first.
testRun.running: AI is testing… This can take up to about a minute.
testRun.blockedTitle: Didn't run because of the safety review. Please revise the rules.

blocker.folder: Folder organization skills don't support test runs.
blocker.fields: Enter a valid command, description, and rules first.

error.unavailable: AI isn't responding right now. Please test again in a moment.
error.timeout: The test took too long and was stopped. Please test again in a moment.
error.notReady: Test runs aren't available yet. Please try again after the server is updated.
error.unsupported: This type of skill doesn't support test runs. Only writing, editing, and template skills can be tested.
error.notFound: Couldn't find the document to test. Select a different document.
error.conflict: This test request was already processed. Please test again.
error.tooLarge: The document is too large to test (over 5 MB).
error.markdownOnly: Only Markdown documents can be tested. Select a different document.
error.rejected: AI didn't run a test with this skill. Make the rules more specific.
